basics.name: Facundo Meoni
basics.label: Developer
basics.summary:
23 years old, argentinian full-stack developer and technology entrepreneur, currently building digital products and managing e-commerce operations through my own agency, ElBarto. My work sits at the intersection of business strategy and software engineering.

I specialize in building scalable web applications and taking full ownership of technical infrastructures. As an AI-native developer, I heavily integrate tools like Cursor and AI CLIs into my daily workflow to accelerate problem-solving, optimize data structures, and deliver faster, higher-quality results. I care deeply about performance, automation, and the details that make digital experiences feel seamless.

Along the way, I've managed end-to-end Tiendanube operations—handling everything from custom web design to targeted email marketing—engineered interactive tools for the urban culture scene, and designed robust backend architectures. My core stack includes React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, SQL, PostgreSQL, and Supabase.

work.name: Elbarto
work.summary: Founded an independent digital agency to provide high-performance tech solutions for modern brands. We offer a complete suite of services including custom web development, end-to-end Tiendanube maintenance, and the creation of interactive digital products and tailored applications.

work.name: Software studio
work.summary: Tasked with developing conversion-oriented e-commerce platforms and web management systems. Led end-to-end optimization within the Tiendanube ecosystem, integrating secure payment gateways, logistics automation, and WhatsApp chatbots. Managed cloud infrastructure migrations on AWS and configured advanced analytics tools to boost SEO performance and scale client sales.

education: I started a degree in Systems at UNNOBA (2021-2022) and continued my career as a self-taught developer. I trained through various courses focused on web development and the integration of Artificial Intelligence tools, always eager to learn and continuously learning!
